title: Decide whether to keep Z-suffixed UTC times in allowed_signers
description: Decide whether to keep Z-suffixed (UTC) valid-after/valid-before in allowed_signers. It sets an OpenSSH 9.1 floor; 8.8 and 9.0 reject every exported line (measured for vouch-tq92.3). Zoneless local times pass on 8.8 but depend on the verifier's TZ and hit the 9.6 DST bug. Unverified: Ubuntu 22.04 ships 8.9p1 and RHEL 9 ships 8.7p1.
close_reason: Decision (Mark 2026-10-23): keep the Z suffix; OpenSSH 9.1 floor is fine
